new_jobs.title: Director, Logistics

new_jobs.title: Logistics Manager
new_jobs.jd: Job Summary We are seeking a seasoned Logistics Manager to lead the end-to-end lifecycle management of our global IT assets. You will be responsible for the strategic planning, cost analysis, warehousing, and hardware inventory management. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of international trade compliance (IOR/EOR), technical hardware specifications, and the ability to leverage data to optimize a complex, high-speed technical supply chain. Key Responsibilities 1. Strategic Asset Lifecycle Management Oversee the full lifecycle of IT equipment, from initial procurement and imaging to secure decommissioning and e-waste disposal (ITAD). Develop and implement Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for global shipping, receiving, and inventory auditing. Manage a multi-million dollar IT asset, providing quarterly review and variance analysis to senior leadership. 2. Global Trade & Compliance Act as the subject matter expert for International Trade Compliance, managing Importer of Record (IOR) and Exporter of Record (EOR) processes. Ensure all shipments comply with HTS/ECCN classifications and local tax/customs regulations (VAT, GST, etc.). Mitigate risks related to transit delays, customs seizures, and shipping damage. 3. Vendor & Carrier Management Negotiate contracts and SLAs with 3PL (Third-Party Logistics) providers, freight forwarders, and various hardware vendors. Conduct regular Business Reviews to ensure vendors meet performance and security standards. 4. Technical Operations & Tools Administer and optimize IT Asset Management (ITAM) software and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS). Manage logistics data with ERP systems and ITSM platforms to ensure "single source of truth" data accuracy. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 7–10 years in logistics or supply chain, with at least 5 years specifically focused on IT hardware or High-Tech sectors. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Information Technology, or Business Administration. Technical Savvy: Proficiency in ERP (Oracle Netsuite) preferred. Certifications: PMP, CSCP (Certified Supply Chain Professional), or CITAM (Certified IT Asset Manager) preferred. Analytical Mindset: Ability to define and track KPIs such as Inventory Accuracy Rate, Mean Time to Deploy, and Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).

new_jobs.jd: **Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for *all* .** Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. **About The Team** The Smart Manufacturing & AI (SMAI) team uses data science, machine learning and AI to improve yield in Micron's front-end memory fabs. As a senior member of the team, you will also set technical direction, review others' work and mentor junior data scientists. What you bring **Required** * Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science or a related field. * 5+ years of hands-on experience applying data science or machine learning to real-world problems * Solid foundation in statistics, experimental design and machine learning * Proven track record of deploying models to production and driving measurable business impact. * Excellent communication skills. new_jobs.title: GNTC - AI Product Manager
new_jobs.jd: **介紹 GNTC 團隊** GNTC 團隊致力於打造企業級 AI 工作平台，讓 AI 深入企業的資料與工作流程，協助團隊提升工作效率、產出品質與決策能力。我們希望 AI 不只是被拿來嘗試的新工具，而是能融入日常工作、持續創造價值的工作夥伴。 隨著產品上市與持續發展，我們正在尋找一位兼具 **市場洞察、技術理解與執行能力的 AI Product Manager** ，與團隊共同推進產品的下一個階段。 你將從產品願景出發，結合市場與競品研究、企業客戶需求，與團隊共同制定產品策略，並轉化為具體的產品路線圖與開發計畫。同時與工程團隊協作推進產品迭代，負責任務分派與交付管理，並透過數據與客戶回饋持續驗證產品價值。 **你將在團隊參與⋯** **市場研究與產品機會探索** * 主動研究 AI 市場、同類產品與新興應用，透過實際操作及使用情境比較，理解競品的能力、限制與價值，提出適合 GNTC 的產品發展建議。 * 透過客戶訪談、工作流程梳理與使用回饋，辨識影響付費意願及持續使用的關鍵問題，將個別需求轉化為可延伸的產品機會。 **產品規劃與管理** * 根據產品策略方向，結合市場研究與客戶需求，提出產品路線圖，與團隊確認關鍵取捨，並主導後續需求規劃與執行。 * 能運用 AI 工具建立 agent、工作流程或 prototype，驗證產品價值與關鍵假設，作為正式開發的決策依據。 **工程團隊協作與產品交付** * 負責任務分派、優先排序與交付時程管理，並排除執行阻礙。 * 與工程團隊釐清問題，評估實作方案，綜合效益、開發成本與技術風險，確認產品範圍與執行方向。 * 推動功能驗收、分階段發布與上線後追蹤，管理變更風險，兼顧交付效率與既有客戶的使用品質。 產品成效與價值溝通 * 建立並追蹤產品成效指標，檢視付費轉換、功能採用、使用頻率與留存，結合數據及客戶回饋提出改善方案。 * 整理產品定位、價值主張與對外溝通內容，將技術能力轉化為客戶能理解的應用情境與商業價值。 * 結合市場研究、競品分析與使用者洞察，定義產品定位及差異化價值，並與行銷團隊合作推動 GTM 策略。 **我們期待看到一個優秀的 AI Product Manager 具備以下能力** * 產品策略與成果導向：能從產品願景提出策略與優先順序建議，協調取捨並獨立推進交付，並透過使用數據、客戶回饋與商業成效驗證成果、持續改善。 * 技術理解與問題分析能力： 理解 API、資料流程、系統整合、Agent Harness 及軟體開發流程，與工程師分析問題及評估方案，將技術討論轉化為明確的產品範圍及執行決策。 * AI 工具應用與評估能力：能運用 AI 工具建立可操作的 agent、工作流程或 prototype，驗證產品想法與可行性，並將 AI 產品體驗轉化為可衡量的標準，設計與執行評估（Eval），持續改善產品品質。 * 任務分配與交付管理能力：具備直接協調工程團隊的經驗，能拆解模糊目標、安排工作優先順序、協調分工與時程，主動處理阻礙並推動完成。 * 溝通與協調能力：面對不同意見與持續變動的需求，能清楚說明影響與取捨，提出可執行的選項，協助團隊形成決策與共識。 **如果你擁有以下能力，那就更棒了！** * 曾負責企業軟體或 B2B SaaS 產品，理解企業採購決策與實際使用者需求的差異，具備產品上線後持續迭代的經驗。 * 曾負責企業 AI、AI agent、自動化工作流程或系統整合相關產品。 * 曾推動企業產品的付費轉換、使用頻率或留存改善，並能分享具體成果。 * 具備軟體工程背景或程式開發能力，能更深入參與技術驗證與方案討論。 * 熟悉 LLM 應用、工具串接 、MCP，並理解 AI 應用品質、回應速度與使用成本之間的取捨。 * 曾在精實團隊中獨立承擔產品規劃與交付工作，建立需求評估、開發協作與交付流程。 **薪資待遇** * 面議 **注意事項** * 如果團隊覺得有機會合作，一起讓 GNTC 往更高的目標邁進，我們會儘速聯絡您！ * 若不符合職位需求的面試者，將不另行通知。 * 如果尋找到合適的人選加入，職缺可能會提前關閉。 * 如果人選在申請過程中提供不實資訊，團隊有權取消雇用提議。 * 在 GNTC 團隊，每位夥伴都是平等的，我們重視每個人的多元性。GNTC 致力於打造一個多元與共融的環境，尊重並且包容每一位夥伴。我們相信，平等與多元能夠帶來無限創新的可能。因此，我們的招聘流程提供每位應徵者平等的就業機會，並落實無歧視的就業環境。 *狄卡科技股份有限公司及其關係企業基於「員工招募」之目的，將蒐集您的「識別類、特徵類、社會情況、教育、考選、技術或其他專業、受僱情形」等個人資料，或您主動為求職目的而提供的資料（履歷、自傳等），以在招募期間及地區內，作為本次招募作業審核、評選、聯繫之用。如您未獲錄取，我們仍將保留您的資料以便向您通知新的職缺機會。* *您得以致電狄卡科技股份有限公司及其關係企業（電子信箱：* *hr.ta@dcard.cc* *）行使請求查閱、補充、更正；請求提供複製本；請求停止蒐集、處理、利用；請求刪除個人資料等權利。如您未正確、完整提供各項資料，將可能影響聘用審核、評選或聯繫。*

new_jobs.title: Data Compression Research Engineer
new_jobs.jd: ****Company:**** Qualcomm Semiconductor Limited ****Job Area:**** Engineering Group, Engineering Group > Video Standards Engineering ****General Summary:**** Qualcomm's Multimedia R&D and Standards Group is seeking candidates for the position of Data Compression Research Engineer with a focus on compression algorithms for neural network and multimedia systems. You will join a world-renowned team of experts who develop algorithms, hardware architectures, and systems for video and data compression. You will participate in the design, implementation and evaluation of state-of-the-art real-time ultra-low latency hardware data compression codecs and will work with hardware and software SOC teams to further optimize developed solutions based on feedback from internal and external customers. The ideal candidate will be a highly self-directed individual with strong creative and analytic skills, and a passion for machine learning and compression technologies. We are considering candidates with various levels of experience. **Responsibilities:** * Contribute to the conception, development, implementation, and optimization of new algorithms delivering improved compression, both lossy and lossless, for various data sources and formats. * Manage design trade-offs between compression performance and hardware complexity. * Participate in the design and implementation of the next generation of Snapdragon solutions. * Collaborate with global technology teams to collect and understand compression needs to define codec tool requirements. All Qualcomm employees are expected to actively support diversity on their teams, and in the company. **Ideal Candidate Would Have The Skills/experience Below:** * Industry or academic experience required in one or more of the following areas: digital signal processing, image/video processing, image/video compression or information theory. * Knowledge of computer architecture and hardware design. Knowledge of quantitatively assessing hardware implementation requirements of algorithms preferred. * Record of innovation: publications or granted patents in the areas of data compression, including video and image coding, digital signal processing, or information theory. * Proficiency in programming and debugging using C/C++, Python, and MATLAB. * Strong written and verbal English communication skills, great work ethic, and ability to work in a team environment to accomplish common goals. **Minimum Qualifications:** * PhD or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, or similar fields. * 1+ years of experience with programming language such as C, C++, Python, MATLAB, etc. ****Minimum Qualifications:**** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related field and 2+ years of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR Master's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related field and 1+ year of Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related work experience. OR PhD in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or related field. **Applicants** : Qualcomm is an equal opportunity employer. If you are an individual with a disability and need an accommodation during the application/hiring process, rest assured that Qualcomm is committed to providing an accessible process. You may e-mail disability-accomodations@qualcomm.com or call Qualcomm's toll-free number found here. Upon request, Qualcomm will provide reasonable accommodations to support individuals with disabilities to be able participate in the hiring process. Qualcomm is also committed to making our workplace accessible for individuals with disabilities. (Keep in mind that this email address is used to provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities. We will not respond here to requests for updates on applications or resume inquiries). Qualcomm expects its employees to abide by all applicable policies and procedures, including but not limited to security and other requirements regarding protection of Company confidential information and other confidential and/or proprietary information, to the extent those requirements are permissible under applicable law. **To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies** : Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Qualcomm. Staffing and recruiting agencies and individuals being represented by an agency are not authorized to use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes, and any such submissions will be considered unsolicited. Qualcomm does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Qualcomm employees or any other company location. Qualcomm is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes/applications. If you would like more information about this role, please contact Qualcomm Careers.
